verses.original: שְׁמוּאֵל֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל יְהוָה֙ שָׁלַ֤ח אֹתִ֨י לִמְשָׁחֳךָ֣ לְמֶ֔לֶךְ עַל־ עַמּ֖וֹ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְעַתָּ֣ה שְׁמַ֔ע לְק֖וֹל דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: šə·mū·’êl way·yō·mer ’el- šā·’ūl Yah·weh šā·laḥ ’ō·ṯî lim·šā·ḥo·ḵā lə·me·leḵ ‘al- ‘am·mōw ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·‘at·tāh šə·ma‘ lə·qō·wl diḇ·rê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then Samuel said to Saul The LORD sent me to anoint you king over His people . . . Israel Now therefore listen . . . to the words of the LORD

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אָמַר֙ פָּקַ֕דְתִּי אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ עֲמָלֵ֖ק עָשָׂ֥ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֥ם לוֹ֙ בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ בַּעֲלֹת֖וֹ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ā·mar pā·qaḏ·tî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ă·mā·lêq ‘ā·śāh lə·yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- śām lōw bad·de·reḵ ba·‘ă·lō·ṯōw mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts says I witnessed - what the Amalekites did to the Israelites when they opposed them on their way up from Egypt

verses.original: עַתָּה֩ לֵ֨ךְ וְהִכִּֽיתָ֜ה אֶת־ עֲמָלֵ֗ק וְהַֽחֲרַמְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א תַחְמֹ֖ל עָלָ֑יו וְהֵמַתָּ֞ה מֵאִ֣ישׁ עַד־ אִשָּׁ֗ה מֵֽעֹלֵל֙ וְעַד־ יוֹנֵ֔ק מִשּׁ֣וֹר וְעַד־ שֶׂ֔ה מִגָּמָ֖ל וְעַד־ חֲמֽוֹר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh lêḵ wə·hik·kî·ṯāh ’eṯ- ‘ă·mā·lêq wə·ha·ḥă·ram·tem ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer- lōw wə·lō ṯaḥ·mōl ‘ā·lāw wə·hê·mat·tāh mê·’îš ‘aḏ- ’iš·šāh mê·‘ō·lêl wə·‘aḏ- yō·w·nêq miš·šō·wr wə·‘aḏ- śeh mig·gā·māl wə·‘aḏ- ḥă·mō·wr
verses.literal: Now go and attack - the Amalekites and devote to destruction - all that belongs to them Do not spare them but put to death men and women children and infants oxen and sheep camels and donkeys

verses.original: שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת־ וַיְשַׁמַּ֤ע הָעָ֔ם וַֽיִּפְקְדֵם֙ בַּטְּלָאִ֔ים מָאתַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף רַגְלִ֑י וַעֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים אֶת־ אִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl ’eṯ- way·šam·ma‘ hā·‘ām way·yip̄·qə·ḏêm baṭ·ṭə·lā·’îm mā·ṯa·yim ’e·lep̄ raḡ·lî wa·‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ’eṯ- ’îš yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: So Saul - summoned the troops and numbered them at Telaim 200,000 {} . . . foot soldiers and 10,000 . . . . . . men of Judah

verses.original: שָׁא֖וּל וַיָּבֹ֥א עַד־ עִ֣יר עֲמָלֵ֑ק וַיָּ֖רֶב בַּנָּֽחַל׃
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl way·yā·ḇō ‘aḏ- ‘îr ‘ă·mā·lêq way·yā·reḇ ban·nā·ḥal
verses.literal: Saul came to the city of Amalek and lay in wait in the valley

verses.original: שָׁא֣וּל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶֽל־ הַקֵּינִ֡י וְאַתָּ֞ה עָשִׂ֤יתָה חֶ֙סֶד֙ עִם־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּעֲלוֹתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם לְכוּ֩ סֻּ֨רוּ רְד֜וּ מִתּ֣וֹךְ עֲמָלֵקִ֗י פֶּן־ אֹֽסִפְךָ֙ עִמּ֔וֹ קֵינִ֖י וַיָּ֥סַר מִתּ֥וֹךְ עֲמָלֵֽק׃
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl way·yō·mer ’el- haq·qê·nî wə·’at·tāh ‘ā·śî·ṯāh ḥe·seḏ ‘im- kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ba·‘ă·lō·w·ṯām mim·miṣ·rā·yim lə·ḵū su·rū rə·ḏū mit·tō·wḵ ‘ă·mā·lê·qî pen- ’ō·sip̄·ḵā ‘im·mōw qê·nî way·yā·sar mit·tō·wḵ ‘ă·mā·lêq
verses.literal: And he warned . . . the Kenites Since you showed kindness to all the Israelites . . . when they came up out of Egypt go on vvv and get away from the Amalekites Otherwise I will sweep you away with them So the Kenites moved away from the Amalekites

verses.original: שָׁא֖וּל אֶת־ וַיַּ֥ךְ עֲמָלֵ֑ק בּוֹאֲךָ֣ מֵֽחֲוִילָה֙ שׁ֔וּר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl ’eṯ- way·yaḵ ‘ă·mā·lêq bō·w·’ă·ḵā mê·ḥă·wî·lāh šūr ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Then Saul - struck down the Amalekites all the way from Havilah to Shur which is - east of Egypt

verses.original: וַיִּתְפֹּ֛שׂ אֶת־ אֲגַ֥ג מֶֽלֶךְ־ עֲמָלֵ֖ק חָ֑י וְאֶת־ הֶחֱרִ֥ים לְפִי־ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם חָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·pōś ’eṯ- ’ă·ḡaḡ me·leḵ- ‘ă·mā·lêq ḥāy wə·’eṯ- he·ḥĕ·rîm lə·p̄î- kāl- hā·‘ām ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: He captured - Agag king of Amalek alive - but devoted . . . all the others {to destruction} with the sword

verses.original: שָׁא֨וּל וְהָעָ֜ם עַל־ וַיַּחְמֹל֩ אֲגָ֗ג וְעַל־ מֵיטַ֣ב הַצֹּאן֩ וְהַבָּקָ֨ר וְהַמִּשְׁנִ֤ים וְעַל־ הַכָּרִים֙ וְעַל־ הַטּ֔וֹב כָּל־ וְלֹ֥א אָב֖וּ הַחֲרִימָ֑ם הֶחֱרִֽימוּ׃פ וְכָל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֛ה נְמִבְזָ֥ה וְנָמֵ֖ס אֹתָ֥הּ
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl wə·hā·‘ām ‘al- way·yaḥ·mōl ’ă·ḡāḡ wə·‘al- mê·ṭaḇ haṣ·ṣōn wə·hab·bā·qār wə·ham·miš·nîm wə·‘al- hak·kā·rîm wə·‘al- haṭ·ṭō·wḇ kāl- wə·lō ’ā·ḇū ha·ḥă·rî·mām he·ḥĕ·rî·mū wə·ḵāl ham·mə·lā·ḵāh nə·miḇ·zāh wə·nā·mês ’ō·ṯāh
verses.literal: Saul and his troops . . . spared Agag along with the best of the sheep and cattle the fat calves and lambs and the best of everything else vvv They were unwilling to devote them to destruction but they devoted to destruction all vvv that was despised and worthless -

verses.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה וַֽיְהִי֙ אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: də·ḇar- Yah·weh way·hî ’el- šə·mū·’êl lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Samuel saying

verses.original: נִחַ֗מְתִּי כִּֽי־ שָׁאוּל֙ הִמְלַ֤כְתִּי אֶת־ לְמֶ֔לֶךְ כִּֽי־ שָׁב֙ מֵאַֽחֲרַ֔י וְאֶת־ לֹ֣א הֵקִ֑ים דְּבָרַ֖י לִשְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיִּ֙חַר֙ וַיִּזְעַ֥ק אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה כָּל־ הַלָּֽיְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: ni·ḥam·tî kî- šā·’ūl him·laḵ·tî ’eṯ- lə·me·leḵ kî- šāḇ mê·’a·ḥă·ray wə·’eṯ- lō hê·qîm də·ḇā·ray liš·mū·’êl way·yi·ḥar way·yiz·‘aq ’el- Yah·weh kāl- hal·lā·yə·lāh
verses.literal: I regret that I have made Saul king - - for he has turned away from following Me and has not carried out My instructions And Samuel was distressed and cried out to the LORD all that night

verses.original: בַּבֹּ֑קֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֧ם לִקְרַ֥את שָׁא֖וּל וַיֻּגַּ֨ד לִשְׁמוּאֵ֜ל לֵאמֹ֗ר שָׁא֤וּל בָּֽא־ הַכַּרְמֶ֙לָה֙ וְהִנֵּ֨ה מַצִּ֥יב יָ֔ד לוֹ֙ וַיִּסֹּב֙ וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֔ר וַיֵּ֖רֶד הַגִּלְגָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bab·bō·qer šə·mū·’êl way·yaš·kêm liq·raṯ šā·’ūl way·yug·gaḏ liš·mū·’êl lê·mōr šā·’ūl bā- hak·kar·me·lāh wə·hin·nêh maṣ·ṣîḇ yāḏ lōw way·yis·sōḇ way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr way·yê·reḏ hag·gil·gāl
verses.literal: Early in the morning Samuel got up to confront Saul but [he] was told . . . . . . Saul has gone to Carmel and behold he has set up a monument for himself and has turned . . . and gone down to Gilgal

verses.original: שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל וַיָּבֹ֥א אֶל־ שָׁא֑וּל שָׁא֗וּל וַיֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣וֹ לַֽיהוָ֔ה בָּר֤וּךְ אַתָּה֙ הֲקִימֹ֖תִי אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃ דְּבַ֥ר
verses.transliteration: šə·mū·’êl way·yā·ḇō ’el- šā·’ūl šā·’ūl way·yō·mer lōw Yah·weh bā·rūḵ ’at·tāh hă·qî·mō·ṯî ’eṯ- Yah·weh də·ḇar
verses.literal: When Samuel reached . . . him Saul said to him May the LORD bless you I have carried out - the LORD’s instructions

verses.original: שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר וּמֶ֛ה הַזֶּ֖ה בְּאָזְנָ֑י קֽוֹל־ הַצֹּ֥אן וְק֣וֹל הַבָּקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י שֹׁמֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·mū·’êl way·yō·mer ū·meh haz·zeh bə·’ā·zə·nāy qō·wl- haṣ·ṣōn wə·qō·wl hab·bā·qār ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî šō·mê·a‘
verses.literal: But Samuel replied Then what [is] this - bleating of sheep and lowing of cattle that I hear

verses.original: שָׁא֜וּל וַיֹּ֨אמֶר הָעָם֙ עַל־ הֱבִיא֗וּם אֲשֶׁ֨ר מֵעֲמָלֵקִ֣י חָמַ֤ל מֵיטַ֤ב הַצֹּאן֙ וְהַבָּקָ֔ר לְמַ֥עַן זְבֹ֖חַ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְאֶת־ הַיּוֹתֵ֖ר הֶחֱרַֽמְנוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl way·yō·mer hā·‘ām ‘al- hĕ·ḇî·’ūm ’ă·šer mê·‘ă·mā·lê·qî ḥā·mal mê·ṭaḇ haṣ·ṣōn wə·hab·bā·qār lə·ma·‘an zə·ḇō·aḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·’eṯ- hay·yō·w·ṯêr he·ḥĕ·ram·nū
verses.literal: Saul answered The troops . . . brought them - from the Amalekites they spared the best sheep and cattle to sacrifice to the LORD your God but the rest we devoted to destruction

verses.original: הֶ֚רֶף וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל וְאַגִּ֣ידָה לְּךָ֔ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֛ה דִּבֶּ֧ר אֵלַ֖י הַלָּ֑יְלָה דַּבֵּֽר׃ס וַיֹּאמְרוּ ל֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: he·rep̄ way·yō·mer šə·mū·’êl ’el- šā·’ūl wə·’ag·gî·ḏāh lə·ḵā ’êṯ ’ă·šer Yah·weh dib·ber ’ê·lay hal·lā·yə·lāh dab·bêr way·yō·mə·rū lōw
verses.literal: Stop exclaimed Samuel - - Let me tell you - what the LORD said to me last night Tell me Saul replied

verses.original: שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אִם־ אַתָּה֙ קָטֹ֤ן בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ אָ֑תָּה הֲל֗וֹא רֹ֛אשׁ שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יְהוָ֛ה וַיִּמְשָׁחֲךָ֧ לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šə·mū·’êl way·yō·mer ’im- ’at·tāh qā·ṭōn bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ’āt·tāh hă·lō·w rōš šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl Yah·weh way·yim·šā·ḥă·ḵā lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And Samuel said Although you [were once] small in your own eyes have you not become the head of the tribes of Israel The LORD anointed you king over Israel

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלָחֲךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בְּדָ֑רֶךְ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לֵ֣ךְ וְהַחֲרַמְתָּ֞ה אֶת־ הַֽחַטָּאִים֙ אֶת־ עֲמָלֵ֔ק וְנִלְחַמְתָּ֣ ב֔וֹ עַ֥ד כַּלּוֹתָ֖ם אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·lā·ḥă·ḵā Yah·weh bə·ḏā·reḵ way·yō·mer lêḵ wə·ha·ḥă·ram·tāh ’eṯ- ha·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm ’eṯ- ‘ă·mā·lêq wə·nil·ḥam·tā ḇōw ‘aḏ kal·lō·w·ṯām ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: and sent . . . you on a mission saying Go and devote to destruction - the sinful - Amalekites Fight against them until you have wiped them out -

verses.original: וְלָ֥מָּה לֹא־ שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וַתַּ֙עַט֙ אֶל־ הַשָּׁלָ֔ל וַתַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lām·māh lō- šā·ma‘·tā bə·qō·wl Yah·weh wat·ta·‘aṭ ’el- haš·šā·lāl wat·ta·‘aś hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: So why did you not obey . . . the LORD Why did you rush upon the plunder and do evil in the sight of the LORD

verses.original: שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה שָׁא֜וּל אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר וַיֹּ֨אמֶר וָאֵלֵ֕ךְ בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֑ה שְׁלָחַ֣נִי וָאָבִ֗יא אֶת־ אֲגַג֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמָלֵ֔ק וְאֶת־ הֶחֱרַֽמְתִּי׃ עֲמָלֵ֖ק
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·tî bə·qō·wl Yah·weh šā·’ūl ’el- šə·mū·’êl ’ă·šer way·yō·mer wā·’ê·lêḵ bad·de·reḵ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh šə·lā·ḥa·nî wā·’ā·ḇî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḡaḡ me·leḵ ‘ă·mā·lêq wə·’eṯ- he·ḥĕ·ram·tî ‘ă·mā·lêq
verses.literal: But I did obey . . . the LORD Saul - - - replied I went on the mission that the LORD gave me I brought back - Agag king of Amalek - and devoted the Amalekites {to destruction}

verses.original: הָעָ֧ם וַיִּקַּ֨ח צֹ֥אן וּבָקָ֖ר מֵהַשָּׁלָ֛ל רֵאשִׁ֣ית הַחֵ֑רֶם לִזְבֹּ֛חַ לַֽיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בַּגִּלְגָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ām way·yiq·qaḥ ṣōn ū·ḇā·qār mê·haš·šā·lāl rê·šîṯ ha·ḥê·rem liz·bō·aḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bag·gil·gāl
verses.literal: The troops took sheep and cattle from the plunder the best of the things devoted to destruction in order to sacrifice [them] to the LORD your God at Gilgal

verses.original: שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לַֽיהוָה֙ הַחֵ֤פֶץ בְּעֹל֣וֹת וּזְבָחִ֔ים כִּשְׁמֹ֖עַ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה הִנֵּ֤ה שְׁמֹ֙עַ֙ ט֔וֹב מִזֶּ֣בַח לְהַקְשִׁ֖יב מֵחֵ֥לֶב אֵילִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šə·mū·’êl way·yō·mer Yah·weh ha·ḥê·p̄eṣ bə·‘ō·lō·wṯ ū·zə·ḇā·ḥîm kiš·mō·a‘ bə·qō·wl Yah·weh hin·nêh šə·mō·a‘ ṭō·wḇ miz·ze·ḇaḥ lə·haq·šîḇ mê·ḥê·leḇ ’ê·lîm
verses.literal: But Samuel declared Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obedience to [His] voice . . . Behold obedience is better than sacrifice [and] attentiveness is better than the fat of rams

verses.original: כִּ֤י מֶ֔רִי חַטַּאת־ קֶ֙סֶם֙ הַפְצַ֑ר וְאָ֥וֶן וּתְרָפִ֖ים יַ֗עַן מָאַ֙סְתָּ֙ אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּמְאָסְךָ֖ מִמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî me·rî ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ- qe·sem hap̄·ṣar wə·’ā·wen ū·ṯə·rā·p̄îm ya·‘an mā·’as·tā ’eṯ- də·ḇar Yah·weh way·yim·’ā·sə·ḵā mim·me·leḵ
verses.literal: For rebellion is like the sin of divination and arrogance is like the wickedness of idolatry Because you have rejected - the word of the LORD He has rejected you as king

verses.original: שָׁא֤וּל וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ שְׁמוּאֵל֙ חָטָ֔אתִי כִּֽי־ עָבַ֥רְתִּי אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת־ פִּֽי־ דְּבָרֶ֑יךָ כִּ֤י יָרֵ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם וָאֶשְׁמַ֖ע בְּקוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl way·yō·mer ’el- šə·mū·’êl ḥā·ṭā·ṯî kî- ‘ā·ḇar·tî ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·’eṯ- pî- də·ḇā·re·ḵā kî yā·rê·ṯî ’eṯ- hā·‘ām wā·’eš·ma‘ bə·qō·w·lām
verses.literal: Then Saul said to Samuel I have sinned - I have transgressed - the LORD’s - commandment and your instructions because I feared - the people and obeyed their voice

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה נָ֖א אֶת־ שָׂ֥א חַטָּאתִ֑י וְשׁ֣וּב עִמִּ֔י וְאֶֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh nā ’eṯ- śā ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî wə·šūḇ ‘im·mî wə·’eš·ta·ḥă·weh Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now therefore please - forgive my sin and return with me so I can worship the LORD

verses.original: לֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב עִמָּ֑ךְ שְׁמוּאֵל֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל כִּ֤י מָאַ֙סְתָּה֙ אֶת־ דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּמְאָסְךָ֣ מִהְי֥וֹת מֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō ’ā·šūḇ ‘im·māḵ šə·mū·’êl way·yō·mer ’el- šā·’ūl kî mā·’as·tāh ’eṯ- də·ḇar Yah·weh Yah·weh way·yim·’ā·sə·ḵā mih·yō·wṯ me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: I will not return with you Samuel replied - - For you have rejected - the word of the LORD and [He] has rejected you as king over Israel

verses.original: שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל וַיִּסֹּ֥ב לָלֶ֑כֶת וַיַּחֲזֵ֥ק בִּכְנַף־ מְעִיל֖וֹ וַיִּקָּרַֽע׃
verses.transliteration: šə·mū·’êl way·yis·sōḇ lā·le·ḵeṯ way·ya·ḥă·zêq biḵ·nap̄- mə·‘î·lōw way·yiq·qā·ra‘
verses.literal: As Samuel turned to go Saul grabbed the hem of his robe and it tore

verses.original: שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ יְהוָ֜ה אֶֽת־ קָרַ֨ע מַמְלְכ֧וּת יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵעָלֶ֖יךָ הַיּ֑וֹם וּנְתָנָ֕הּ לְרֵעֲךָ֖ הַטּ֥וֹב מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·mū·’êl way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw Yah·weh ’eṯ- qā·ra‘ mam·lə·ḵūṯ yiś·rā·’êl mê·‘ā·le·ḵā hay·yō·wm ū·nə·ṯā·nāh lə·rê·‘ă·ḵā haṭ·ṭō·wḇ mim·me·kā
verses.literal: So Samuel said to him The LORD - has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today and has given it to your neighbor [who is] better than you

verses.original: וְגַם֙ נֵ֣צַח יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יְשַׁקֵּ֖ר יִנָּחֵ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹ֥א ה֖וּא וְלֹ֣א אָדָ֛ם לְהִנָּחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam nê·ṣaḥ yiś·rā·’êl lō yə·šaq·qêr yin·nā·ḥêm kî lō hū wə·lō ’ā·ḏām lə·hin·nā·ḥêm
verses.literal: Moreover the Glory of Israel does not lie or change His mind for . . . He is not a man that He should change His mind

verses.original: חָטָ֔אתִי וַיֹּ֣אמֶר נָ֛א כַּבְּדֵ֥נִי עַתָּ֗ה נֶ֥גֶד זִקְנֵֽי־ עַמִּ֖י וְנֶ֣גֶד יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשׁ֣וּב עִמִּ֔י וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֵ֖יתִי לַֽיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·ṭā·ṯî way·yō·mer nā kab·bə·ḏê·nî ‘at·tāh ne·ḡeḏ ziq·nê- ‘am·mî wə·ne·ḡeḏ yiś·rā·’êl wə·šūḇ ‘im·mî wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wê·ṯî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: I have sinned Saul replied Please honor me now before the elders of my people and before Israel Come back with me so that I may worship the LORD your God

verses.original: שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל וַיָּ֥שָׁב אַחֲרֵ֣י שָׁא֑וּל שָׁא֖וּל וַיִּשְׁתַּ֥חוּ לַֽיהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: šə·mū·’êl way·yā·šāḇ ’a·ḥă·rê šā·’ūl šā·’ūl way·yiš·ta·ḥū Yah·weh
verses.literal: So Samuel went back with Saul and Saul worshiped the LORD

verses.original: שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַגִּ֤ישׁוּ אֵלַי֙ אֶת־ אֲגַג֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמָלֵ֔ק אֲגַ֖ג וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֵלָ֔יו מַעֲדַנֹּ֑ת אֲגָ֔ג וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אָכֵ֖ן מַר־ הַמָּֽוֶת׃ס סָ֥ר
verses.transliteration: šə·mū·’êl way·yō·mer hag·gî·šū ’ê·lay ’eṯ- ’ă·ḡaḡ me·leḵ ‘ă·mā·lêq ’ă·ḡaḡ way·yê·leḵ ’ê·lāw ma·‘ă·ḏan·nōṯ ’ă·ḡāḡ way·yō·mer ’ā·ḵên mar- ham·mā·weṯ sār
verses.literal: Then Samuel said Bring me - Agag king of the Amalekites Agag came to him cheerfully for he thought Surely the bitterness of death is past

verses.original: שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר חַרְבֶּ֔ךָ נָשִׁים֙ שִׁכְּלָ֤ה כֵּן־ אִמֶּ֑ךָ תִּשְׁכַּ֥ל מִנָּשִׁ֖ים שְׁמוּאֵ֧ל אֶת־ אֲגָ֛ג וַיְשַׁסֵּ֨ף לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בַּגִּלְגָּֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: šə·mū·’êl way·yō·mer ka·’ă·šer ḥar·be·ḵā nā·šîm šik·kə·lāh kên- ’im·me·ḵā tiš·kal min·nā·šîm šə·mū·’êl ’eṯ- ’ă·ḡāḡ way·šas·sêp̄ lip̄·nê Yah·weh bag·gil·gāl
verses.literal: But Samuel declared As your sword has made women childless so your mother will be childless among women And Samuel - hacked Agag to pieces before the LORD at Gilgal

verses.original: שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ הָרָמָ֑תָה וְשָׁא֛וּל עָלָ֥ה אֶל־ בֵּית֖וֹ גִּבְעַ֥ת שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: šə·mū·’êl way·yê·leḵ hā·rā·mā·ṯāh wə·šā·’ūl ‘ā·lāh ’el- bê·ṯōw giḇ·‘aṯ šā·’ūl
verses.literal: Then Samuel went to Ramah but Saul went up to his home in Gibeah of Saul

verses.original: עַד־ י֣וֹם מוֹת֔וֹ כִּֽי־ שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל וְלֹא־ יָסַ֨ף לִרְא֤וֹת אֶת־ שָׁאוּל֙ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל הִתְאַבֵּ֥ל אֶל־ שָׁא֑וּל וַיהוָ֣ה נִחָ֔ם כִּֽי־ שָׁא֖וּל הִמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- yō·wm mō·w·ṯōw kî- šə·mū·’êl wə·lō- yā·sap̄ lir·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- šā·’ūl šə·mū·’êl hiṯ·’ab·bêl ’el- šā·’ūl Yah·weh ni·ḥām kî- šā·’ūl him·lîḵ ’eṯ- ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And to the day of his death . . . Samuel never again visited - Saul Samuel mourned for Saul and the LORD regretted that He had made Saul king - over Israel
